Laura Bates on Misogyny

It's Complicated
Nov 2 2020 • 47 mins
The second of two episodes timed around the US Election, looking at the subject of speech online and how we disagree and debate. Laura Bates, founder of the Everyday Sexism Project joins us this week to talk about the shocking research behind her new book 'Men Who Hate Women'; underground online communities of men (which Laura went undercover in) focused around extreme misogyny which spill over into real-world threats, abuse and violence. *Please do subscribe, rate and review if you enjoy the podcast*
